summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K disclosing weekly progress under its EUR 30 million share buyback program announced on 30 October 2025. From 1-5 June 2026 the company repurchased 79,318 shares at an average price of EUR 5.72 per share, for total consideration of EUR 454,021. Total repurchases since program start on 26 January 2026 amount to 887,440 shares (1.5% of outstanding) for EUR 4,144,651. The program is executed via a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary through Nasdaq. This is an ongoing capital return program, not a self-tender or going-private, and the filing is a routine periodic update.
